diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate status job, not a separate build failure. .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-88 explicitly exits 1 when common or test-latest-deps fails. The frozen common/test1 jobs and testLatestDeps1 fail the producer-batch regression because its scope expectation is incorrect. The candidate fixes that PR-attributable cause; the separate Java 8 template ordering flake is described on its own job diagnosis.

The newly added testProducerBatchWithMessageListener expects io.opentelemetry.spring-rabbit-1.0 at SpringRabbitMqTest.java:481, but SpringRabbitInstrumentationModule.java:23 names the module spring-rabbit-1.1, as do the adjacent existing tests and the frozen emitted spans. All four simple/direct and success/failure scenarios in this job emit spring-rabbit-1.1 and the intended batch counts (3 on success, 2 on partial failure). Correct the assertion, not the working production scope. The candidate makes only that test expectation change.

metadata.body:
Producer-packed batches delivered to an ordinary `MessageListener` were counted as one message. Count logical deliveries within the Spring processing span so `messaging.client.consumed.messages` and `messaging.batch.message_count` reflect delivered fragments, including when a failure prevents delivery of the remaining batch.

- **Accounting:** Count fragment dispatches rather than trusting producer count headers; retain single-message and list-batch behavior.
- **Ownership:** Preserve producer correlation, error handling, context cleanup, and Spring/RabbitMQ processing ownership. Leave `consumerBatchEnabled` unchanged.
- **Coverage:** Add installed-javaagent regressions for simple and direct containers across baseline/latest dependencies, including partial delivery failure and misleading count headers.
metadata.title: Fix Spring Rabbit producer-batch message undercounting
